# Looks: every effect that restyles a source

Looks rework what's under them: the shared source (built-in photo slideshow, the user's image, video or gradient) or a scene earlier in the same style. Stack 1–3; each is a full-screen pass.

## Print & Halftone

Ink on paper: halftone screens, riso overprints, engraving.

### Halftone (`halftone`)

A rotated print screen of round ink dots.

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cell` | Cell Size | slider | 3 … 48 | 10 |
| `angle` | Screen Angle | slider | 0 … 1.57 | 0.4 |

Colours: `colorA` Paper {"r":0.93,"g":0.92,"b":0.88}, `colorB` Ink {"r":0.07,"g":0.08,"b":0.1}.

### Crosshatch (`crosshatch`)

Engraved pen hatching that deepens with shadow.

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `spacing` | Spacing | slider | 3 … 18 | 6 |

Colours: `colorA` Paper {"r":0.93,"g":0.92,"b":0.88}, `colorB` Ink {"r":0.07,"g":0.08,"b":0.1}.

### Risograph (`risograph`)

Two-ink riso print with grain and misregistration.

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `screen` | Screen | menu | 0 Grain · 1 Halftone | 0 (Grain) |
| `cell` | Dot Size | slider | 2 … 16 | 4 |
| `misreg` | Misregistration | slider | 0 … 16 | 5 |
| `paper` | Paper Texture | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.5 |

Colours: `colorA` Ink 1 {"r":1,"g":0.28,"b":0.53}, `colorB` Ink 2 {"r":0,"g":0.47,"b":0.75}.

## Dither & Pixel

1-bit and low-bit dithering, pixels and mosaics.

### Dithering (`dither`)

Ordered, blue-noise and error-diffusion dithering, 1-bit or color.

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `algo` | Algorithm | menu | 0 Bayer 2×2 · 1 Bayer 4×4 · 2 Bayer 8×8 · 3 Blue Noise · 4 Floyd–Steinberg · 5 Atkinson · 6 Jarvis-Judice-Ninke · 7 Stucki · 8 Burkes · 9 Sierra · 10 Sierra 2-Row · 11 Sierra Lite · 12 Fan · 13 Shiau-Fan · 14 Shiau-Fan 2 · 15 Simple 2D · 16 Riemersma | 1 (Bayer 4×4) |
| `cell` | Pixel Size | slider | 1 … 16 (step 1) | 2 |
| `levels` | Levels | slider | 2 … 8 (step 1) | 2 |
| `mono` | Monochrome | toggle | 0 / 1 | on |

Colours: `colorA` Background {"r":0,"g":0,"b":0}, `colorB` Foreground {"r":1,"g":1,"b":1}.

## Retro Screens

### Pixel Sort (`pixelSort`)

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `thr` | Threshold | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.5 |
| `len` | Max Length | slider | 4 … 120 | 48 |

### VHS (`vhs`)

Tape wobble, color bleed and a roll bar.

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | Amount | slider | 0 … 2 | 1 |

|---|---|---|---|---|

|---|---|---|---|---|

| `scale` | Scale | slider | 1 … 24 | 6 |

|---|---|---|---|---|
